annotations.title: Check whether a store promotion is real

description: Whether a Polish store's promotion (a crossed-out price) is real: the advertised discount against the lowest price of the 30 days before the cut, from the store's own Omnibus figure or TagDip's history, and whether TagDip ever saw the crossed-out price. Pass the url of the store's product page, or product_id with an optional store name; without a store, every store's promotion on the product is checked. Useful in sales such as Black Friday. Documentation: https://tagdip.pl/ai

store.description: With product_id: only this store, e.g. "x-kom".

url.description: Instead of product_id: a tagdip.pl product page, or a product page of a Polish store TagDip tracks.
